{{Expand Ukrainian|topic=bio|date=December 2014}}{{Short description|Canadian inventor, industrialist and chemist of Ukrainian origin}}
'''Vladimir Nicolaus Mackiw''' (August 4, 1923, [[Ivano-Frankivsk|Stanisławów]] – 2001, [[Islington-City Centre West|Islington]])<ref>{{Cite web |title=Мацків, Володимир-Микола |url=http://vue.gov.ua/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%B2,_%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%80-%D0%9C%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B0 |access-date=2024-02-12 |website=ВУЕ |language=uk}}</ref> was a [[Canadian]] [[inventor]], [[industrialist]], and [[chemist]] of [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] origin who revolutionized the mining industry with his inventions and techniques.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Мацьків Володимир |url=https://esu.com.ua/article-67207 |access-date=2024-02-12 |website=esu.com.ua}}</ref>

He received an honorary degree from the [[University of Alberta]] in 1976, and the Gold Medal of the [[Institute of Mining and Metallurgy in London]], England, in 1977.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mackiw, Vladimir |url=https://www.encyclopediaofukraine.com/display.asp?linkpath=pages%5CM%5CA%5CMackiwVladimir.htm |website=Internet Encyclopedia of Ukraine | access-date=2026-01-14}}</ref>
